title: K-th Smallest Prime Fraction
description: Find the k-th smallest fraction formed by arr[i] / arr[j] where i < j.

steps.note: Initialize binary search range [0, 1] for array [1, 2, 3, 5]
Calculate mid = 0.5. Search for count of fractions <= 0.5
Binary search converges, found target fraction [1, 3] as the 3rd smallest.
